name: flightdeck
description: Coordinate portable multi-repository engineering, operations, research, artifacts, and compliance work.

interface.longDescription: Generates a local control plane, discovers and connects existing repositories in place with safe local bridges, creates right-sized plans, routes findings-first reviews to exact owning projects, preserves approval boundaries, validates workspace health, upgrades safely with patch notes, and provides reusable engineering, CI/CD, platform, automation, artifact, compliance, and STIG workflows.
defaultPrompt: Set up Flightdeck for the Git repositories under this folder.
Plan or review this cross-repository change, including owners, dependencies, risks, findings, and validation.
Upgrade my Flightdeck plugin without changing my existing Hub or repositories, and show me what changed.
